simple.meaning: the lobe or flap of the liver (as if redundant or outhanging)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יֹתֶרֶת (H3508) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

simple.summary: יֹתֶרֶת (yôthereth) means the lobe or flap of the liver (as if redundant or outhanging) First listed occurrence: Exod 29 13.

definitions.short: the lobe or flap of the liver (as if redundant or outhanging)
definitions.full: H3508. yothereth יֹתֶ֫רֶת noun feminine appendage (technical term of P); — most probably (fat) appendage , a (fatty) mass at opening of liver of sacrificial animal, extending to kidneys (see Di Dr Polychr. Bible, Lev 3:4 ); **GFM (Dec. 28, 1899, privately points out that fat parts are always distinguished from this; compare now on יתדת Id. SACRIFICE EB 4206 and especially Id. Oriental. Stud. für Th. Nöldeke (1906), 761 , where it is shewn to be the caudate lobe of the liver. — עַלהַֿכָּבֵד הַיֹּתֶרֶת Exod 29:13 ; Lev 3:4 , 10 , 15 ; 4:9 ; 7:4 ; ׳הַיּ מִןהַֿכָּבֵד 9:10 ; construct הַכָּבֵד יֹתֶרֶת Exod 29:22 ; Lev 8:16 , 25 ; 9:19 (all P).
